first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: A person sitting on the Dirt Road, with long light-colored hair, wearing a beige patterned short-sleeved top and a long white skirt, barefoot.

entities.name: Dilapidated White Wooden House
entities.identification: The low white horizontal-plank house in the center background, with a gabled front wall, a damaged roof, and a porch on the left.

entities.name: Dirt Road
entities.identification: The broad grayish-brown bare ground extending from the image foreground to the front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Grayish-White Sky
entities.identification: The bright, relatively uniform Grayish-White Sky behind the roof and tree branches.

entities.name: Weeds on Both Sides of the Road
entities.identification: Green clumps of grass and withered yellow plants growing together on the image-left and image-right sides of the road and in front of the wooden house.

entities.name: Dead Tree on the Image-Left
entities.identification: The tree on the left side of the wooden house, with a slender grayish-brown main trunk and leafless branches, its upper end partially out of frame.

entities.name: Distant Wooden Shed on the Image-Right
entities.identification: The low, crooked grayish-brown wooden shed in the distant view on the right side of the wooden house.

entities.name: Person B
entities.identification: The foreground person gradually entering the frame from the image-right edge, with brown trousers and part of a dark shoe visible, while the head and upper body are out of frame.
